@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+# Run systemd inside a Podman Container
+
+Podman supports systemd support out of the box. Here are 4 examples using Fedora, RedHat, Oracle and OpenSUSE based images.
+
+## Host configuration
+
+The container_manage_cgroup boolean must be enabled for this to be allowed on an SELinux separated system.
+
+```bash
+sudo setsebool -P container_manage_cgroup true
+```
+
+## Build container
+
+```Dockerfile
+RUN curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/users/${USERNAME}/keys | jq --raw-output '.[] | .key' > /tmp/authorized_keys &&\
+    chmod 600 /tmp/authorized_keys 
+```
+
+### Fedora
+
+```bash
+podman build --tag systemd \
+             --build-arg BASEIMAGE=docker.io/fedora:35 \
+             --build-arg USERNAME=$USERNAME redhat
+```
+
+### ORACLE Linux
+
+```bash
+podman build --tag systemd \
+             --build-arg BASEIMAGE=docker.io/oraclelinux:8.5 \
+             --build-arg USERNAME=$USERNAME redhat
+```
+
+### RHEL ubi
+
+```bash
+podman build --tag systemd \
+             --build-arg BASEIMAGE=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi8/ubi:8.5 \
+             --build-arg USERNAME=$USERNAME redhat
+```
+
+### OpenSUSE
+
+```bash
+podman build --tag systemd \
+             --build-arg BASEIMAGE=docker.io/opensuse/leap:15.3 \
+             --build-arg USERNAME=$USERNAME opensuse
+```
+
+## Run container
+
+```bash
+podman run -d --rm -p 2022:22 --systemd=true --name systemd systemd
+```
+
+## Connect container via ssh
+
+```bash
+ ssh -p 2022 localhost
+ ```
+
+## Links
+
+- [How to run systemd in a container](https://developers.redhat.com/blog/2019/04/24/how-to-run-systemd-in-a-container)

+ARG BASEIMAGE=docker.io/nixos/nix:2.7.0
+ARG GITHUB_USERNAME=octocat
+ARG CONTAINER_USERNAME=${GITHUB_USERNAME}
+ARG CONTAINER_UID=1000
+ARG CONTAINER_GID=${CONTAINER_UID}
+
+# ============= builder =============
+FROM docker.io/alpine as builder
+
+RUN apk add curl jq
+
+WORKDIR /build
+ARG GITHUB_USERNAME
+RUN curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/users/${GITHUB_USERNAME}/keys | jq --raw-output '.[] | .key' > /build/authorized_keys &&\
+    chmod 600 /build/authorized_keys
+
+# ============== main ===============
+FROM ${BASEIMAGE}
+
+RUN nix-env -i gnused openssh shadow sudo systemd
+
+#RUN ssh-keygen -A &&\
+#    sed -i -r -e "s/^#?\s*(%wheel.*ALL)/# \\1/" -e "s/^#?\s*(%wheel.*NOPASSWD: ALL)/\\1/" /etc/sudoers
+
+ARG CONTAINER_USERNAME
+ARG CONTAINER_UID
+ARG CONTAINER_GID
+RUN groupadd -g ${CONTAINER_GID} ${CONTAINER_USERNAME} &&\
+    groupadd -g 10 wheel &&\
+    useradd -u ${CONTAINER_UID} -g ${GID} -G wheel --create-home ${USERNAME} &&\
+    mkdir -p /home/${UCONTAINER_SERNAME}/.ssh/ &&\
+    ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -a 100 -f /home/${USERNAME}/.ssh/id_ed25519 -N '' &&\
+    chown -R ${CONTAINER_USERNAME}:${CONTAINER_USERNAME} /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh
+
+COPY --from=builder --chown=${CONTAINER_USERNAME}:${CONTAINER_USERNAME} /build/authorized_keys /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh/authorized_keys
+
+LABEL de.wstein.repo=github.com/wstein/podman-systemd
+
+ENTRYPOINT [ "/usr/lib/systemd/systemd" ]

+ARG BASEIMAGE=docker.io/opensuse/leap:15.3
+ARG GITHUB_USERNAME=octocat
+ARG CONTAINER_USERNAME=${GITHUB_USERNAME}
+ARG CONTAINER_UID=1000
+ARG CONTAINER_GID=${CONTAINER_UID}
+
+# ============= builder =============
+FROM docker.io/alpine as builder
+
+RUN apk add curl jq
+
+WORKDIR /build
+ARG GITHUB_USERNAME
+RUN curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/users/${GITHUB_USERNAME}/keys | jq --raw-output '.[] | .key' > /build/authorized_keys &&\
+    chmod 600 /build/authorized_keys
+
+# ============== main ===============
+FROM ${BASEIMAGE}
+
+RUN zypper --non-interactive in openssh-server sudo systemd && zypper clean --all
+
+RUN ssh-keygen -A &&\
+    sed -i -r -e "s/^#?\s*(%wheel.*ALL)/# \\1/" -e "s/^#?\s*(%wheel.*NOPASSWD: ALL)/\\1/" /etc/sudoers
+
+ARG CONTAINER_USERNAME
+ARG CONTAINER_UID
+ARG CONTAINER_GID
+RUN groupadd -g ${CONTAINER_GID} ${CONTAINER_USERNAME} &&\
+    groupadd -g 10 wheel &&\
+    useradd -u ${CONTAINER_UID} -g ${GID} -G wheel --create-home ${USERNAME} &&\
+    mkdir -p /home/${UCONTAINER_SERNAME}/.ssh/ &&\
+    ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -a 100 -f /home/${USERNAME}/.ssh/id_ed25519 -N '' &&\
+    chown -R ${CONTAINER_USERNAME}:${CONTAINER_USERNAME} /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh
+
+COPY --from=builder --chown=${CONTAINER_USERNAME}:${CONTAINER_USERNAME} /build/authorized_keys /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh/authorized_keys
+
+LABEL de.wstein.repo=github.com/wstein/podman-systemd
+
+ENTRYPOINT [ "/usr/lib/systemd/systemd" ]

+ARG BASEIMAGE=docker.io/oraclelinux:8.5
+ARG GITHUB_USERNAME=octocat
+ARG CONTAINER_USERNAME=${GITHUB_USERNAME}
+ARG CONTAINER_UID=1000
+ARG CONTAINER_GID=${CONTAINER_UID}
+
+# ============= builder =============
+FROM docker.io/alpine as builder
+
+RUN apk add curl jq
+
+WORKDIR /build
+ARG GITHUB_USERNAME
+RUN curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/users/${GITHUB_USERNAME}/keys | jq --raw-output '.[] | .key' > /build/authorized_keys &&\
+    chmod 600 /build/authorized_keys
+
+# ============== main ===============
+FROM ${BASEIMAGE}
+
+RUN dnf -y install openssh-server sudo && dnf clean all
+
+RUN ssh-keygen -A &&\
+    sed -i -r -e "s/^#?\s*(%wheel.*ALL)/# \\1/" -e "s/^#?\s*(%wheel.*NOPASSWD: ALL)/\\1/" /etc/sudoers
+
+ARG CONTAINER_USERNAME
+ARG CONTAINER_UID
+ARG CONTAINER_GID
+RUN groupadd -g ${CONTAINER_GID} ${CONTAINER_USERNAME} &&\
+    useradd -u ${CONTAINER_UID} -g ${CONTAINER_GID} -G wheel --create-home ${CONTAINER_USERNAME} &&\
+    mkdir -p /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh/ &&\
+    ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -a 100 -f /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh/id_ed25519 -N '' &&\
+    chown -R ${CONTAINER_USERNAME}:${CONTAINER_USERNAME} /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh
+
+COPY --from=builder --chown=${CONTAINER_USERNAME}:${CONTAINER_USERNAME} /tmp/authorized_keys /home/${CONTAINER_USERNAME}/.ssh/authorized_keys
+
+LABEL de.wstein.repo=github.com/wstein/podman-systemd
+
+ENTRYPOINT [ "/sbin/init" ]
+
